metadata.question: Was it hotter in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS LST 8-day composites (MOD11A2 v6.1) for daytime LST over a 30-mile radius around Kabul (Point[69.2075, 34.5553], buffer 48280 m). Compare February 2017 vs February 2018. If empty collection, fallback to MYD11A2 (Aqua).
2. Masking strategy: Apply QC_Day mask (bits 0-1 == 0 and bits 2-3 <= 2) to keep good-quality LST pixels. Compute mean LST in Celsius. Report valid pixel counts and coverage (%) as a proxy for cloud/invalid screening.
3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If no valid pixels after masking -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [-100, 80] C -> C3. Otherwise compare 2018 > 2017 => A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const kabulp = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]);
    const radius_m = 30 * 1609.34; // 30 miles in meters
    const aoi = kabulp.buffer(radius_m);
    const periods = {
      y2017: {start: '2017-02-01', end: '2017-03-01'},
      y2018: {start: '2018-02-01', end: '2018-03-01'}
    };

    // Helpers
    const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((res, rej) => obj.getInfo(res, rej));

    function maskMOD11A2(img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const goodProd = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 0
      const dataQualOK = qc.rightShift(2).bitwiseAnd(3).lte(2); // allow 0,1,2
      return img.updateMask(goodProd.and(dataQualOK));
    }

    function prepareCollection(datasetId, start, end, geom) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .map(function(img) {
          const masked = maskMOD11A2(img);
          const lstC = masked.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST');
          return lstC.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
        });
    }

    async function statsForPeriod(start, end, geom) {
      // Try MOD11A2 first, then MYD11A2 if empty
      let dataset = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2';
      let col = prepareCollection(dataset, start, end, geom);
      let size = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        dataset = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A2';
        col = prepareCollection(dataset, start, end, geom);
        size = await getInfo(col.size());
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        return {dataset, size, mean: null, validCount: 0, totalCount: 0, coveragePct: 0, empty: true};
      }
      const meanImg = col.mean().rename('LST');
      const validDict = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const validCount = validDict ? (validDict.LST || 0) : 0;

      const totalDict = await getInfo(ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const totalCount = totalDict ? (totalDict.one || 0) : 0;

      let meanVal = null;
      if (validCount > 0) {
        const meanValDict = await getInfo(meanImg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }));
        meanVal = meanValDict ? meanValDict.LST : null;
      }
      const coveragePct = totalCount > 0 ? (100 * validCount / totalCount) : 0;
      return {dataset, size, mean: meanVal, validCount, totalCount, coveragePct, empty: false};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check + Processing
    const s2017 = await statsForPeriod(periods.y2017.start, periods.y2017.end, aoi);
    const s2018 = await statsForPeriod(periods.y2018.start, periods.y2018.end, aoi);

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Dataset 2017: ${s2017.dataset}`);
    console.log(`Dataset 2018: ${s2018.dataset}`);
    console.log(`2017 Images: ${s2017.size}`);
    console.log(`2018 Images: ${s2018.size}`);

    // Handle empty-collection case
    if (s2017.empty || s2018.empty) {
      console.log('One or both periods have empty collections after fallback.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); // evidence line trimmed
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Handle no valid pixels after masking
    console.log(`2017 ValidPx: ${s2017.validCount}/${s2017.totalCount} (Cover: ${s2017.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2018 ValidPx: ${s2018.validCount}/${s2018.totalCount} (Cover: ${s2018.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    if (s2017.validCount === 0 || s2018.validCount === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Calculation, Validation, and Final Answer
    const m2017 = s2017.mean;
    const m2018 = s2018.mean;

    // Validate means
    function invalidMean(v) {
      return (v === null || isNaN(v) || v < -100 || v > 80);
    }
    if (invalidMean(m2017) || invalidMean(m2018)) {
      console.log(`Means invalid. 2017: ${m2017}, 2018: ${m2018}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = m2018 - m2017;
    console.log(`2017 Mean LST (C): ${m2017.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`2018 Mean LST (C): ${m2018.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Delta 2018-2017 (C): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`);

    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
